info.description: A person who takes part in a session. Called "Contributor" in code, "Collaborator" everywhere an editor or visitor reads it.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot. There is no page_layout attribute and no region — a collaborator's page is two-column by construction, and its main region holds a single implicit ContributorProfile block built from the four content attributes above.

edit.label: Name
edit.description: What this collaborator is called. It is the page's heading, and the page's URL is derived from it.

edit.label: Role
edit.description: What they do, in a line. Shown beneath the name.

edit.label: Portrait
edit.description: A picture of them, shown beside the prose.

edit.label: Blurb
edit.description: A paragraph or two about them. The page's main column.

edit.label: Page shell
edit.description: The site chrome that wraps this page. Left empty, it fills itself from the default page shell.

edit.label: Events
edit.description: Derived from the collaborator's published sessions. Not editable.
